preop_note_claims: History includes hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and chronic kidney disease stage 2.
Current medications include amlodipine 10mg daily, lisinopril 20mg daily, metformin 500mg twice daily, atorvastatin 20mg nightly, aspirin 75mg daily, and omeprazole 20mg daily (stopped).

ASA Physical Status III assigned due to multiple comorbidities (hypertension, diabetes, hyperlipidemia, CKD).
Airway assessment includes Mallampati score and thyromental distance documented.
Anesthetic plan includes spinal anesthesia with local infiltration for transurethral resection of the prostate.
handoff_claims: Key history includes penicillin allergy with rash, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, hyperlipidemia, and chronic kidney disease stage 2.
Intraoperative course: spinal anesthesia with local infiltration administered without complications.
Anticipated postoperative issues include monitoring for fluid overload and renal function due to chronic kidney disease stage 2.
Home medications to be resumed postoperatively except omeprazole which was discontinued preoperatively.
